This list is a compilation of frequencies from Rife frequency researchers. Here you can
find the biggest rife frequency database in the world. You can experience these
frequencies and see whether they work for you. If a frequency program makes you feel
uncomfortable, please stop running it until you feel better. Please note that these
frequencies are only for experiments.
Feel free to share with us what frequencies have helped you overcome your health
problems. Happy rifing!
Spooky2 has the biggest rife frequency database in the world. It has 13 sub-databases,
including BP, DNA, MW, PROV, CAFL, KHZ or BIO, etc. Most people are wondering what

these abbreviations mean. Here is a breakdown of what each one is:
PROV has produced consistent results in virtually all subjects it was used with.

MW is a collection of about 8,000 programs for drugs, supplements, and molecules
important to health.

BP is a collection of more than 10,000 programs for human, animal, and plant
pathogens based on their base pair values.

DNA is a collection of about 1,700 programs for virus, bacteria, pathogens based on
their DNA.

BIO and VEGA are both excellent, based on Russian frequency research.

CAFL is the Consolidated Annotated Frequency List, amassed from the experience of
Rife experimenters over years.

XTRA is a collection of sets from various sources, all chosen for their reputation for
effectiveness.

CUST is your own personal database.

RIFE is a collection of Dr. Royal Raymond Rife’s original frequencies.

HC is Dr. Hulda Clark’s database.

ETDFL is a collection of programs researched in Bioresonance Clinics in Germany.

KHZ is a collection of higher frequencies.

ALT consists of sets based on Ayurvedic knowledge and practice, Solfeggios, and
planetary frequencies.
